emily: Quick thread: OrionCompute asked for a tight acceptance checklist for a joint perf/W benchmark before we go to press. Need measurable gates and an artifact bag.

noah: Agree. Keep it actionable. Suggest: hardware + ambient, pinned drivers, workload, steady-state window, and pass/fail logic.

sam: Concrete numbers would help partners. Maybe perf/W within 6% of our baseline OR throughput >= 95% while keeping 95th latency within +20ms. Also require no thermal throttling.

tara: Call out reproducibility: 3 runs on at least 2 racks (6 runs total); coefficient of variation for throughput <4%. Ask partners to provide dockerfile + driver pins and condensed perf logs.

emily: Draft gate summary:
- Rig: Orion X1 8-card chassis, inlet 23C +/-2C, medium airflow
- SW: ubuntu-22.04, nvidia-driver 535.y, rwd-runtime v2.4.1, model rwd-7b-quant (fp16 + int8 paths)
- Workload: 512-token prompts, 16 clients, 20m steady state after 5m warmup
- Metrics: seq/s (avg), 95/99 lat, wall power (W), perf/W = seq/s / avg_power(W)
- Stability: 3 runs per rack, total 6; var <4%; no dmesg throttle events; package temps <85C
- Pass: perf/W within 6% of Redwood ref OR throughput >=95% with 95th <= ref+20ms. If power capping used, document changes and ensure throughput loss <8%.

sam: For observability ask for telegraf/prom metrics and an anonymized KV cache sample for one run (no raw tokens). We'll ingest artifacts into console.

bench-bot: created job rwd-orion-1799 scheduled 2026-09-10T13:00Z. Artifact bucket: s3://redwood-partner-artifacts/rwd-orion-1799/ Results will post to #partnerships-results.

noah: I'll own artifacts ingestion. Tara, can you draft the methods appendix (ambient, pins, kernel flags)?

tara: On it. Also will prepare a short mitigations checklist for thermal issues (fan curves, power capping policy, slight memory freq tweak).

emily: I'll send this one-pager to Orion eng + legal for signoff. Public release will include only aggregated perf/W and a short methods paragraph; raw logs stay partner-only.

bench-bot: job rwd-orion-1799 updated: s3 bucket created and permissions granted to orion-eng@orion.com.

emily: Thanks team  closing until runs complete  will reopen with link and numbers. :white_check_mark:
